name: AnyNight v1.9.5 — 开场动画 / opening sequence
body:
## 中文

**这一版加了一段开场。**

安装包约 366 KB，`minSdk 30`（Android 11+）。覆盖安装即可，设置和已选应用都在。

### 开场动画

第一次打开（含升级后第一次）会播 20.5 秒：白天在光里讲效率，暗处才见作者本意，最后落到名字。四扇窗外形统一，纯色块和细微色差在窗内画出阅读、相册、相机、聊天。

- **纯代码绘制**（`Canvas` + 属性动画），没有一张图片、**没有新增任何权限**，安装包只多了 22 KB。
- 按 390×844 设计稿等比铺满、`contain` 居中：19.5:9、16:9 直屏、平板、折叠屏展开都能正确落位，切形态不会重建页面。
- 前三幕固定米白 / 近黑两色，**不跟系统深浅色**——那是「白天 / 暗处」的语义对照，反相会把意思讲反。**只有第四幕跟随主题**：夜里用深底浅字收尾，直接接上深色首页。
- 系统动画缩放为 0 时跳过；点屏幕可提前结束；**长按首页标题 AnyNight 可重看**。

### 转场

播完不再空淡出。开场末帧本身就是页面底色，交给首页后由首页盖一层同色遮罩揭开，620 ms 淡到透明——浅色和深色两种系统模式下都不会露黑边、不会闪跳。

### 首次启动顺序

`开场 → 首页（停 700 ms）→ 使用教程`。那 700 ms 是留给「名字化开、界面就在那儿」的落点，否则刚淡完就被教程顶走。


## English

**This one adds an opening sequence.**

~366 KB, `minSdk 30` (Android 11+). Installs straight over 1.9.4; your settings and app list stay.

### The opening

First launch (including the first launch after an update) plays a 20.5-second sequence: efficiency in daylight, intent only visible in the dark, closing on the name. Four windows share one shape; flat blocks and slight shade differences draw reading, photos, camera and chat inside them.

- **Drawn entirely in code** (`Canvas` + property animators) — no images, **no new permissions**, +22 KB.
- Laid out on a 390×844 artboard and scaled with `contain`: 19.5:9, 16:9, tablets and unfolded foldables all land correctly, and changing form factor does not recreate the page.
- The first three acts are fixed off-white / near-black and **do not follow the system theme** — that contrast is the point of the script. **Only the last act follows it**: at night it closes dark-on-light-text and hands straight over to the dark home screen.
- Skipped when animator duration scale is 0; a tap ends it early; **long-press the home title** to replay.

### Hand-off

No more trailing blank fade. The last frame already equals the page background; the home screen lays a veil of that same colour over itself and fades it out in 620 ms, so neither light nor dark mode shows a black edge or a jump.

### First-run order

`opening → home (700 ms) → tutorial`. Those 700 ms let the name dissolve with the UI already in place.
